functionalReqs: Free and paid tiers with different limits and models
hints: What does a request look like end to end, from the browser to a GPU and back as a stream?
Conversation history grows. How do you keep each request within the context window and budget?

Client ↔ API gateway (auth, per-user token-based rate limits) ↔ chat service (loads history, truncates or summarises to fit context, applies system prompt) ↔ safety classifier ↔ inference router (model per tier, queue with priorities) ↔ GPU inference fleet with continuous batching and KV cache; responses streamed via SSE; messages stored in a sharded DB; prompt caching for shared prefixes; usage metering per tier.
nonFunctionalReqs: Time to first token under 1 s
Safety filtering on inputs and outputs
problemStatement:
Design a **ChatGPT-like consumer chat service**: users have multi-turn conversations with an LLM, see responses stream token by token, and can come back to old chats.

GPU capacity is expensive and limited, so serving efficiency, rate limits and cost control are as important as features.
title: Design a ChatGPT-like LLM Chat Service
